Mission Plan, 1946. The Assembly consisted

held its first meeting on December 9, 1946.

items.text:
The Fundamental Rights are enshrined in Part 
III of the Constitution from Articles 12 to 35. 
In this regard, the framers of the Constitution 
derived inspiration from the Constitution of 
USA. Originally, the Constitution provided for 
seven Fundamental Rights. At present, there 
are only six Fundamental Rights. Part III of the 
Constitution is rightly described as the Magna 
Carta of India. While Fundamental Rights are 
available to all persons, certain Fundamental 
Rights are available only to Indian Citizens.

Constitution are inspired by the Constitution 
of former USSR (Russia). In 1976, the 
Congress party set up the Sardar Swaran Singh 
Committee to make recommendations on 
fundamental duties. The 42nd Amendment Act

Duties. This amendment added a new part, 
namely, Part IVA to the Constitution. This new 
part consists of only one Article that is Article 
51A which for the first time specified a code of 
eleven fundamental duties of the citizens.
